transcript.content: Hi, I’m glad you came in. What brings you in today?

I’m here because I’m having a hard time staying on task. Even with important work stuff… I’ll be looking into a client’s network problem, and after a while I realize I’ve read the same log lines over and over and still don’t really know what they said.
Did you have trouble paying attention like this when you were a child?

Yeah… I think so. My mom still brings it up sometimes. She says my report cards always had that “bright, but…” kind of comment—like I wouldn’t stay in my seat, I’d call out answers, and I’d lose homework even when I’d actually done it.
Do you often feel restless or fidgety as an adult?

Yeah. Pretty often. Even when I’m supposed to just sit and listen, it feels like there’s this… motor running under my skin. Like I need to get up, check something, move on to the next thing right away.
Do these focus problems cause trouble for you outside of work too?

Yeah. It’s… not just work exactly. Since I left my old job and don’t have that structure, things have slipped. I’ve lost some freelance clients because I didn’t follow through the way I should’ve. There was a senior service-manager role I didn’t get, and… my wife and I have had to worry about money more than I’d like to admit. People just don’t really trust me to come through right now.
Do you often feel anxious or unable to stop worrying?
I don’t know… not in a constant way, I guess. I worry about things, sure, but I’m not sure I’d say I can’t stop.
Have you been feeling down or depressed most days?
I… I don’t think most days, no. I get frustrated, worn out maybe, but depressed? I’m not sure I’d call it that.
Do these attention problems cause trouble for you at home?

Yeah… at home it shows up mostly as follow-through, I guess. Since I lost the structure of my old job, things have kind of unraveled. My wife and I have had to worry more about money, and… people don’t really trust me to come through like they used to. I’ve lost clients, missed out on a better role. It’s caused tension, yeah.
Were these focus problems already present before you left your old job?

Yeah… I mean, it wasn’t new. My mother still brings up my grade school report cards — that I was “bright,” but I wouldn’t stay in my seat, blurted things out, lost homework even when I’d done it. So… yeah, it goes back a ways.
Do you have trouble falling asleep or staying asleep?
Sometimes, I guess. I don’t really keep track. It’s not something I’ve paid much attention to.
As a child, did these attention or restlessness problems happen at home too, or mainly at school?

Mostly at school, I guess — at least that’s what got written down. My mother still jokes about the report cards saying I was bright, but I wouldn’t stay in my seat, blurted out answers, and somehow lost homework even when I’d done it.
As a child, did you have these attention or restlessness problems at home?

Yeah… at home too, I think. My mother still jokes about it — same stuff as the report cards, that I was bright but wouldn’t stay in my seat, blurted things out, and somehow lost homework even when I’d done it.
